text: Entry 633 hardcodes a localization revision to unblock build_desktop_file.py during the localization repository transition. Current accepted build_desktop_file.py receives a JSON list of locales and a local translation root; it does not perform that revision checkout. Treat the old change as a temporary build workaround. Preserve current input contracts instead of copying the old revision into new tooling.
title: Do not retain the 2024 hardcoded localization revision workaround
